title: AccountContactRole - Data API
description: Represents the role that a Contact plays on an Account.

AccountId.description: ID of the Account. This is a relationship field.

ContactId.description: ID of the Contact associated with this account. This is a relationship field.

IsDeleted.description: Indicates whether the object has been moved to the Recycle Bin (true) or not (false). Label is Deleted.

IsPrimary.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsPrimary.description: Specifies whether the Contact plays the primary role on the Account (true) or not (false). Note that each account has only one primary contact role. Label is Primary. Default value is false.

Role.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Role.description: Name of the role played by the Contact on this Account, such as Decision Maker, Approver, Buyer, and so on. Must be unique—there can't be multiple records in which the AccountId, ContactId, and Role values are identical. Different contacts can play the same role on the same account. A contact can play different roles on the same account.

special_access_rules: Customer Portal users can't access this object.
usage: Use this object to define the role that a Contact plays on a given Account within the context of a specific Opportunity.
associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. If the API version isn’t specified, they’re available in the same API versions as this object. Otherwise, they’re available in the specified API version and later.

- **AccountContactRoleChangeEvent (API version 44.0)**: Change events are available for the object.
